items.caption: This seal-script style form combines the hand element 扌 on the left with 丁 on the right, matching the recorded analysis of 打 as ‘strike’ formed from hand plus a phonetic 丁.
items.alt: Black seal-style form of 打, with the hand component on the left and 丁 on the right.
items.selection_reason: The image shows the only supported historical-style candidate and illustrates the documented component analysis. It is a modern redraw in Shuowen seal-script style, not an ancient artifact image.

limitations.text: This modern redraw is labelled Shuowen seal-script style, but its specific ancient exemplar and date are not established. No verified oracle-bone or bronze form is available here, so the image does not establish a graphic sequence or earlier ancestor.
